## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: dso ref-query against a representative UI-copy query returns canon entries from the new corpus with relevance scores

## Description
Two coordinated edits across the ref-query bash wrapper and its Python implementation:

1. plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh — argument parser: accept --namespace=<value> and --format=<text|json> flags; pass values through to ref-query.py.
2. plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py — (a) parse --namespace=<value> and filter the BM25 result set to entries where tags.domain == value; (b) when --format=json, serialize each result as a JSON object carrying rule_id, tags, score, body, source_file per the documented JSON schema. Default --format remains text.

JSON output schema documented at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ref-query-json-output.md.

Backward compatibility: queries without --namespace return entries from ALL namespaces and behave identically to pre-task ref-query (no scoring change, no row-shape change).

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given the 6 federal-style canon YAMLs from task-C exist; When ref-query.sh runs with --namespace=canon --format=json against a representative UI-copy query (e.g., 'error message required field'); Then every returned row has tags.domain=='canon' (or 'canon' in tags.domain), AND each row carries a numeric score field, AND the JSON parses against the documented schema. Backward-compat: WITHOUT --namespace, at least one non-canon row appears in baseline output (guards against silent default-to-canon).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ref-query.sh --help advertises --namespace and --format
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh --help 2>&1 | grep -E -- '--namespace' && bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh --help 2>&1 | grep -E -- '--format'
- [ ] --namespace=canon filters to canon-only rows
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-ref-query-namespace.sh
- [ ] Backward-compat: no --namespace returns rows across domains
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-ref-query-namespace.sh test_baseline_includes_non_canon
- [ ] JSON output carries documented schema fields
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh --namespace canon --format json 'error message' | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); assert rows and all(set(['rule_id','tags','score']).issubset(r.keys()) for r in rows)"
- [ ] ref-query-json-output.md contract documented
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ref-query-json-output.md && grep -q 'rule_id' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ref-query-json-output.md && grep -q 'score' plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ref-query-json-output.md
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-ref-query-namespace.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
| plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh | Edit |
| plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.py | Edit |
| plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ref-query-json-output.md | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/test-ref-query-namespace.sh | Create |
| plugins/dso/tests/.test-index | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
